answer: Reputation Decay Escrow. Each new identity must anchor a small escrow that decays only while its owner's interactions stay within an island of low-activity peers; joining an active cluster requires the escrow to expand toward that cluster's nebula-weighted median. The enforcement rule is continuous: attackers pay an escalating per-identity escrow that grows with each additional identity they spin up, because decay resets on every fresh join. Cost scales superlinearly with identity count, so farming N sybils costs roughly N^1.5 in locked capital.
